cur-fossil-malta.dateNote: From 1928 Mikhail Gerasimov dug at Mal'ta, near Lake Baikal in Siberia, and found carved ivory and the grave of a small boy. In 2013 the boy's DNA linked him to Native Americans. He is about 0.024 million years old. Wikidata pins the culture at a rounded point near the village.
cur-fossil-malta.summary: A Siberian boy, 24,000 years old, whose DNA is shared with Native Americans.
